summary: This directory provides a comprehensive abstraction layer for file system operations, including reading, writing, searching, and metadata management, ensuring consistent error handling and utility support for file-based interactions.
responsibilities: Providing service layers for file access and searching
Performing common file system operations like reading, writing, and copying
Normalizing file system errors through custom wrappers
Implementing path matching and globbing utilities
relationships: Service layers utilize file utilities to execute underlying file system operations.
File metadata is used by both service layers and utility functions to provide detailed information about file system entries.
Path matchers integrate with search services to filter and identify specific files or directories.
Utility functions ensure consistent error handling by wrapping native file system calls in standard error types.
designDecisions: Centralization of file system operations to ensure uniform error handling
Abstraction of raw file system calls into high-level service layers
Use of typed wrappers for data persistence and retrieval
Inclusion of schema validation during file reading operations
